obligor_aliases: Methodist Le Bonheur Healthcare Obligated Group

moodys.citation_text: Daily Memphian reports the December 2024 Moody's downgrade was 'from A2 to A3' implying A2 was the prior rating in effect leading up to that 2024 action and on 2022-12-31. No interim Moody's action between 2022 and December 2024 surfaced.

sp.citation_text: Daily Memphian reports December 2024 S&P downgrade 'from A+ to A' (negative outlook), implying A+ was in effect prior. We carry A+/Stable as starting position on 2022-12-31.

fitch.citation_text: Universe v2 records 'fitch: null' for Methodist Le Bonheur; no Fitch coverage surfaced.

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: Downgraded to A3 from A2; outlook negative
rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Cited accelerated operating losses and diminished reserves; first-half 2023 operating loss of $110.3M on $910.5M revenue (-12.1% operating margin) prior to the Epic EHR go-live (October 2024) and Workday implementation that drove accounts-receivable issues during conversion.
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Daily Memphian: 'Moody's reduced Methodist's rating from A2 to A3 in December (2024)... both rate the outlook as negative.' Both Moody's and S&P cited 'accelerated operating losses and diminished reserves'.

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: Downgraded to A from A+; outlook negative
rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Same December 2024 action cycle as Moody's: 'accelerated operating losses and diminished reserves'.
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Daily Memphian: 'Standard and Poor's downgraded Methodist's rating from A+ to A; both rate the outlook as negative.'

moodys.citation_text: A3/Negative after December 2024 downgrade. The further Moody's downgrade to Baa1 (universe v2 source label 'A3 to Baa1') happened in 2025 — Becker's article 'Methodist Le Bonheur downgraded as operating losses accelerate' references the 'second downgrade in just over a year'. Exact 2025 date of the Baa1 downgrade not pinned in this verification; if it fell BEFORE 2025-03-31 the ending rating would be Baa1 instead of A3.
moodys._warning: PARTIALLY VERIFIED: timing of Moody's A3 -> Baa1 downgrade in 2025 not confirmed against the window end 2025-03-31. If the second downgrade was Q1 2025 the ending rating is Baa1/Negative; if Q2+ 2025 the ending rating remains A3/Negative.

sp.citation_text: A/Negative per December 2024 S&P downgrade; universe v2 lists S&P at BBB+ today implying a further notch down occurred but timing not pinned to within or after window.
sp._warning: Universe v2 has S&P at BBB+, implying additional downgrade beyond December 2024 A. Timing uncertain re window end.

outcome_class_rationale: Two agencies (Moody's A2->A3 and S&P A+->A) each downgraded one notch in December 2024 within the window. If the Moody's further notch (A3->Baa1) fell before 2025-03-31, this becomes MULTI_DOWNGRADE driven by 2-notch Moody's action plus 1-notch S&P. With at least one-notch downgrades by both rating agencies that cover the credit during the window, classification = MULTI_DOWNGRADE (per taxonomy: 'one-notch down by 3 agencies' triggers MULTI; here we have 2 agencies but stacking ambiguity from possible 2nd Moody's notch supports the heavier class). Conservative alternative classification: DOWNGRADE (1 notch each at 2 agencies).
